unit.evidence: EN “relative work units” / 中文“相对工作单位” and JA “相対作業量単位” all describe relative work units; this is not an elapsed-time unit.

none.evidence: EN “None” / 中文“无” and JA “なし” all mark absence; the renderer uses the value for empty lists or missing optional fields, not zero.

list_separator.evidence: EN comma-space and Chinese/Japanese “、” are locale punctuation choices; JA preserves list separation when the renderer joins IDs, resources, and blockers.

no_description.evidence: EN “No description” / 中文“无描述” and JA “説明なし” all mark an absent task description; this is the Markdown fallback.

no_deliverable.evidence: EN “No deliverable description” / 中文“无交付物描述” and JA “成果物の説明なし” all describe missing deliverable detail; this is the SVG row fallback.

plan_title.evidence: EN “Project plan” / 中文“项目计划” and JA “プロジェクト計画” give the same plan heading rendered at the top of Markdown.

title.evidence: EN “Title” / 中文“标题” and JA “タイトル” label the title field; the schedule’s supplied title remains unchanged.

summary.evidence: EN “Summary” / 中文“摘要” and JA “概要” label the summary field without claiming a different content type.

workload_unit.evidence: EN “Workload unit” / 中文“工作量单位” and JA “作業量の単位” all label the unit for workload.

capacity.evidence: EN “Parallel capacity” / 中文“并行容量” and JA “並行実行容量” denote the limit on parallel task execution.

capacity_unknown.evidence: EN and Chinese both say capacity is unknown and scheduling is unbounded; JA “未確定；容量の上限を設けずにスケジュール” preserves both the uncertainty and no-limit behavior.

capacity_unknown_short.evidence: EN “Unknown (unbounded scheduling)” / 中文“未知（按无上限排程）” and JA “未確定（容量上限なしのスケジュール）” retain unknown capacity and unbounded scheduling in the short pill.

workload_note.evidence: EN/CN state approximate workload, T+N as relative not hours/workdays/real duration, bars as workload, and hatching as blocked-status-only; JA line 14 preserves all four and limits the hatch meaning to status.

scheduling_note.evidence: EN/CN specify input order as stable priority, release on predecessor work completion, deterministic list scheduling, and no global-optimum promise; JA line 15 explicitly keeps 前提タスク, completion, determinism, and the disclaimer.

assumptions.evidence: EN “Assumptions” / 中文“假设” and JA “前提条件” name the plan’s assumptions section.

risks.evidence: EN “Risks” / 中文“风险” and JA “リスク” name the risks section.

requirements.evidence: EN plural “Requirements” / 中文“需求” and JA “要件” label the requirements collection; the language’s number-neutral form is appropriate.

requirement.evidence: EN singular “Requirement” / 中文“需求” and JA “要件” label one requirement in the mapping table.

source.evidence: EN “Source” / 中文“来源” and JA “出典” identify the provenance/source field, not a task dependency.

coverage.evidence: EN “Covering tasks” / 中文“覆盖任务” and JA “対応タスク” indicate the tasks corresponding to a requirement.

requirement_mapping.evidence: EN “Requirement mapping” / 中文“需求映射” and JA “要件とタスクの対応” explicitly express the same requirement-to-task mapping.

schedule.evidence: EN “Relative workload schedule” / 中文“相对工作量排程” and JA “相対作業量スケジュール” retain both relativity and workload basis.

task.evidence: EN “Task” / 中文“任务” and JA “タスク” are equivalent task labels.

type.evidence: EN “Type” / 中文“类型” and JA “種類” label the task kind/type column.

start.evidence: EN “Relative start” / 中文“相对起点” and JA “相対開始位置” express a relative start position, not a date.

finish.evidence: EN “Relative finish” / 中文“相对终点” and JA “相対終了位置” express the relative endpoint, not an elapsed duration.

workload.evidence: EN “Workload” / 中文“工作量” and JA “作業量” name the amount represented by each scheduled task bar.

dependencies.evidence: EN “Dependencies” / 中文“依赖” and JA “依存関係” label task prerequisite relationships.

resources.evidence: EN “Resources” / 中文“资源” and JA “リソース” label assigned task resources.

status.evidence: EN “Status” / 中文“状态” and JA “状態” label state; no protocol value is translated.

task_details.evidence: EN “Task details” / 中文“任务详情” and JA “タスクの詳細” head the per-task detail UI.

description.evidence: EN “Description” / 中文“描述” and JA “説明” are equivalent detail-field labels.

deliverable.evidence: EN “Deliverable” / 中文“交付物” and JA “成果物” identify the task output.

acceptance.evidence: EN “Acceptance criteria” / 中文“验收标准” and JA “受け入れ条件” both mean conditions for accepting the result.

pr_scope.evidence: EN “PR scope” / 中文“PR 边界” and JA “PR の対象範囲” label the scope covered by the pull request.

estimate_basis.evidence: EN “Estimate basis” / 中文“估算依据” and JA “見積もりの根拠” label the rationale for the estimate.

resource_locks.evidence: EN “Resource locks” / 中文“资源锁” and JA “リソースロック” all identify resources held/locked for the task.

scheduled.evidence: EN “Scheduled” / 中文“已排程” and JA “スケジュール済み” label the scheduled state in human-readable text while leaving the state token unchanged.

blocked.evidence: EN “Blocked” / 中文“阻塞” and JA “ブロック中” label the distinct blocked state.

blocked_reason.evidence: EN/CN say blocked due to unknown or pending external readiness; JA “外部条件の準備状況が未確定” retains the external condition, readiness uncertainty, and {items} blockers.

chart_title.evidence: EN “Project Gantt chart” / 中文“项目甘特图” and JA “プロジェクトのガントチャート” title the same chart.

chart_desc.evidence: EN/CN preserve approximate relative workload, abstract relative ordering rather than calendar time, and no invented positions for blocked tasks; JA line 43 preserves all three and uses {title} for the schedule title.

chart_caption.evidence: EN/CN pair the workload unit {unit} with approximate bar workload; JA line 44 retains both and the same placeholder purpose.

axis_caption.evidence: EN/CN rule out actual/calendar duration; JA “横軸＝相対位置 · 実際の所要期間ではありません” preserves relative position and denies actual duration.

legend_task.evidence: EN/CN label task and bar-length/workload; JA “タスク（棒の長さ＝作業量）” retains both parts in the SVG legend.

legend_milestone.evidence: EN “Milestone” / 中文“里程碑” and JA “マイルストーン” identify the same category.

legend_external.evidence: EN “External item” / 中文“外部项” and JA “外部項目” keep external items distinct from tasks and milestones.

legend_blocked.evidence: EN/CN specify blocked state shown by row background; JA “ブロック状態（行の背景）” preserves both state and visual encoding.

blocked_label.evidence: EN/CN label blocked status due to unknown/pending external readiness; JA preserves that cause and the {items} external-condition list.

blocked_count.evidence: EN/CN report {count} tasks blocked by uncertain external readiness; JA preserves the count, task unit, reason, and blocked status.

schedule_span.evidence: EN/CN give a relative schedule span ending at {finish}; JA “相対スケジュールの範囲：{finish}” preserves relative scope and endpoint.

arrow_note.evidence: JA says arrows indicate dependencies released after completion, matching EN; CN makes predecessor explicit. In the SVG the arrow begins at the predecessor’s finish (build_plan.py:623–632), so the chart context resolves the omitted subject without changing the release condition.

empty_requirements.evidence: EN “No requirements” / 中文“无需求” and JA “要件なし” all state that the mapping table has no requirement rows.

close.evidence: EN “Close” / 中文“关闭” and JA “閉じる” give the dialog’s close button the same action.

completion_blocked.evidence: EN/CN distinguish schedulable finish {finish} from unknown overall finish; JA “スケジュール可能部分…全体の相対終了位置は未確定” retains both the partial endpoint and overall uncertainty.

completion.evidence: EN/CN give a relative finish {finish}; JA “相対終了位置 {finish}” reports the same relative endpoint without implying calendar time.

kind_task.evidence: EN “Task” / 中文“任务” and JA “タスク” correctly label a task kind in the details UI.

kind_milestone.evidence: EN “Milestone” / 中文“里程碑” and JA “マイルストーン” correctly label a milestone kind.

kind_external.evidence: EN “External item” / 中文“外部项” and JA “外部項目” correctly label the external-item kind.
